briefings.tldr: The 2026 OCP EMEA Summit highlighted a major industry-wide transition toward high-density AI infrastructure, driven by open collaborations in high-voltage direct current (DC) power, advanced liquid cooling, and custom silicon like the Arm AGI CPU designed to support the rapid rise of agentic AI.
